name: Break glass / All findings
text:
let btg = users
| where userPrincipalName in~ ({Accounts})
| project userId = id, upn = userPrincipalName, enabled = coalesce(accountEnabled, false), synced = coalesce(onPremisesSyncEnabled, false), userType, assignedLicenses, passwordPolicies, lastPasswordChangeDateTime, signInActivity, memberOf, ownedObjects;
let btgGroups = btg
| project userId, upn
| join kind=leftouter (btg | mv-expand g = memberOf | where tostring(g.objectType) == "group" | summarize groupIds = make_set(tostring(g.id)) by userId) on userId
| project userId, upn, groupIds = coalesce(groupIds, dynamic([]));
let gaRole = roleManagement_directory_roleDefinitions
| where displayName == "Global Administrator"
| project gaId = id, k = 1;
let ca = identity_conditionalAccess_policies
| project policy = displayName, state, exUsers = conditions.users.excludeUsers, exGroups = conditions.users.excludeGroups, exRoles = conditions.users.excludeRoles,
    inUsers = conditions.users.includeUsers, inGroups = conditions.users.includeGroups, inRoles = conditions.users.includeRoles, k = 1;
let acct = btg
| join kind=leftouter (reports_authenticationMethods_userRegistrationDetails | project userId = id, methods = methodsRegistered) on userId
| extend fidoKeys = iff(isnull(methods), long(null), array_length(set_intersect(methods, dynamic(["passKeyDeviceBound"])))),
    otherMethods = iff(isnull(methods), dynamic(null), set_difference(methods, dynamic(["passKeyDeviceBound"])));
let principals = union
    (btg | project userId, upn, principalId = userId, via = "direct"),
    (btg | mv-expand g = memberOf | where tostring(g.objectType) == "group" | project userId, upn, principalId = tostring(g.id), via = strcat("group ", tostring(g.displayName)));
let roleNames = roleManagement_directory_roleDefinitions | project roleDefinitionId = id, role = displayName;
let active = principals
| join kind=inner (roleManagement_directory_roleAssignmentScheduleInstances | project principalId, roleDefinitionId, directoryScopeId, assignmentType, endDateTime) on principalId
| join kind=leftouter roleNames on roleDefinitionId
| summarize permanentGa = countif(role == "Global Administrator" and directoryScopeId == "/" and assignmentType == "Assigned" and isnull(endDateTime)),
    anyGa = countif(role == "Global Administrator" and directoryScopeId == "/"),
    gaVia = make_set_if(via, role == "Global Administrator" and directoryScopeId == "/"),
    extra = make_set_if(role, role != "Global Administrator") by userId;
let eligible = principals
| join kind=inner (roleManagement_directory_roleEligibilityScheduleInstances | project principalId, roleDefinitionId) on principalId
| join kind=leftouter roleNames on roleDefinitionId
| summarize eligibleRoles = make_set(role) by userId;
let roles = btg
| project userId, upn
| join kind=leftouter active on userId
| join kind=leftouter eligible on userId
| extend permanentGa = coalesce(permanentGa, 0), anyGa = coalesce(anyGa, 0), extra = coalesce(extra, dynamic([])), eligibleRoles = coalesce(eligibleRoles, dynamic([]));
let use = btg
| extend interactive = todatetime(signInActivity.lastSignInDateTime), nonInteractive = todatetime(signInActivity.lastNonInteractiveSignInDateTime);
let premium = subscribedSkus
| where capabilityStatus == "Enabled"
| mv-expand plan = servicePlans
| where tostring(plan.servicePlanName) in ("AAD_PREMIUM", "AAD_PREMIUM_P2")
| summarize plans = count();
let fido = policies_authenticationMethodsPolicy_authenticationMethodConfigurations
| where id == "Fido2"
| project state, excludeTargets, includeTargets, keyRestrictions;
union
    (print wanted = {Accounts}
    | mv-expand typed = wanted to typeof(string)
    | extend lower = tolower(typed)
    | join kind=leftanti (btg | project lower = tolower(upn)) on lower
    | project Category = "SYS", Check = "SYS.ResolveUser", Target = typed, Status = "FAIL", Detail = "No user has this UPN, so it isn't checked."),
    (acct | project Category = "ACCT", Check = "ACCT.Enabled", Target = upn, Status = iff(enabled, "PASS", "FAIL"),
        Detail = iff(enabled, "Account is enabled.", "Account is disabled. A break-glass account must be usable.")),
    (acct | project Category = "ACCT", Check = "ACCT.CloudOnly", Target = upn, Status = iff(synced, "FAIL", "PASS"),
        Detail = iff(synced, "Synced from on-premises AD. It must be cloud-only, so an on-premises outage or compromise can't touch it.", "Cloud-only account.")),
    (acct | project Category = "ACCT", Check = "ACCT.UserType", Target = upn, Status = iff(userType == "Member", "PASS", "FAIL"),
        Detail = strcat("userType is ", userType, iff(userType == "Member", ".", "; it must be Member."))),
    (acct | project Category = "ACCT", Check = "ACCT.UpnDomain", Target = upn, Status = iff(upn endswith ".onmicrosoft.com", "PASS", "WARN"),
        Detail = iff(upn endswith ".onmicrosoft.com", "UPN is on the *.onmicrosoft.com domain.", "UPN is on a custom domain. Prefer *.onmicrosoft.com, so a federation or DNS failure can't block sign-in.")),
    (acct | project Category = "ACCT", Check = "ACCT.NoLicense", Target = upn, Status = iff(array_length(assignedLicenses) > 0, "WARN", "PASS"),
        Detail = iff(array_length(assignedLicenses) > 0, strcat(array_length(assignedLicenses), " license(s) assigned. Break-glass accounts should have none (no mailbox, no data)."), "No licenses assigned.")),
    (acct | project Category = "ACCT", Check = "ACCT.PwdNeverExpires", Target = upn, Status = iff(passwordPolicies contains "DisablePasswordExpiration", "PASS", "FAIL"),
        Detail = iff(passwordPolicies contains "DisablePasswordExpiration", "Password expiration is disabled.", "Password can expire. An expired password during an outage locks you out; set DisablePasswordExpiration.")),
    (acct | project Category = "ACCT", Check = "ACCT.Fido2Registered", Target = upn, Status = case(isnull(fidoKeys), "ERROR", fidoKeys > 0, "PASS", "FAIL"),
        Detail = case(isnull(fidoKeys), "No registration details for this account (needs Reports Reader and AuditLog.Read.All).", fidoKeys > 0, "A FIDO2 security key is registered.", "No FIDO2 security key is registered.")),
    (acct | project Category = "ACCT", Check = "ACCT.OnlyFido2", Target = upn, Status = case(isnull(otherMethods), "ERROR", array_length(otherMethods) == 0, "PASS", "FAIL"),
        Detail = case(isnull(otherMethods), "No registration details for this account (needs Reports Reader and AuditLog.Read.All).", array_length(otherMethods) == 0, "Only FIDO2 security keys are registered.", strcat("Other methods are registered: ", strcat_array(otherMethods, ", "), ". Remove them so the account can't be phished or SIM-swapped."))),
    (acct | project Category = "ACCT", Check = "ACCT.NoOwnedObjects", Target = upn, Status = iff(array_length(ownedObjects) > 0, "WARN", "PASS"),
        Detail = iff(array_length(ownedObjects) > 0, strcat("Owns ", array_length(ownedObjects), " object(s) (apps or groups). Break-glass accounts should own nothing."), "Owns no directory objects.")),
    (acct | where isnotnull(lastPasswordChangeDateTime) | project Category = "ACCT", Check = "ACCT.PasswordAge", Target = upn, Status = "INFO",
        Detail = strcat("Password last changed ", datetime_diff("day", now(), lastPasswordChangeDateTime), " day(s) ago.")),
    (ca
    | join kind=inner (btgGroups | extend k = 1) on k
    | join kind=leftouter gaRole on k
    | extend direct = set_has_element(exUsers, userId), viaGroup = array_length(set_intersect(exGroups, groupIds)) > 0,
        roleOnly = set_has_element(exRoles, gaId)
    | extend inScope = set_has_element(inUsers, "All") or set_has_element(inUsers, userId) or array_length(set_intersect(inGroups, groupIds)) > 0 or set_has_element(inRoles, gaId)
    | project Category = "CA", Check = iff(direct or viaGroup, "CA.Excluded", "CA.NotExcluded"), Target = strcat(upn, " | ", policy),
        Status = case(direct or viaGroup, "PASS", state == "disabled", "WARN", inScope, "FAIL", "WARN"),
        Detail = case(direct, "Excluded directly.", viaGroup, "Excluded through a group.",
            state == "disabled", "The policy is off but doesn't exclude the account. Fix it before the policy is turned on.",
            inScope, strcat("[", state, "] The account is in scope and not excluded."),
            strcat("[", state, "] The account isn't targeted now, but isn't excluded either. Exclusion must be explicit.", iff(roleOnly, " Only a role exclusion exists, which doesn't count.", "")))),
    (roles | project Category = "ROLE", Check = "ROLE.GlobalAdminPermanent", Target = upn, Status = iff(permanentGa > 0, "PASS", "FAIL"),
        Detail = case(permanentGa > 0, strcat("Permanent active Global Administrator (", strcat_array(gaVia, ", "), ")."),
            anyGa > 0, "Global Administrator is active but time-bound or activated through PIM. It must be permanent: PIM may be unavailable in the emergency.",
            "No active tenant-wide Global Administrator assignment.")),
    (roles | project Category = "ROLE", Check = "ROLE.NoEligible", Target = upn, Status = iff(array_length(eligibleRoles) > 0, "FAIL", "PASS"),
        Detail = iff(array_length(eligibleRoles) > 0, strcat("PIM-eligible for: ", strcat_array(eligibleRoles, ", "), ". Break-glass accounts must not depend on PIM activation."), "No PIM-eligible assignments.")),
    (roles | project Category = "ROLE", Check = "ROLE.OnlyGlobalAdmin", Target = upn, Status = iff(array_length(extra) > 0, "WARN", "PASS"),
        Detail = iff(array_length(extra) > 0, strcat("Also holds: ", strcat_array(extra, ", "), ". Global Administrator alone is enough."), "Holds only Global Administrator.")),
    (use | project Category = "USE", Check = "USE.NoSignIns", Target = upn,
        Status = case(isnull(signInActivity), "ERROR", coalesce(interactive > ago({Lookback}), false) or coalesce(nonInteractive > ago({Lookback}), false), "FAIL", "PASS"),
        Detail = case(isnull(signInActivity), "Sign-in activity couldn't be read (needs Entra ID P1 and AuditLog.Read.All).",
            coalesce(interactive > ago({Lookback}), false) or coalesce(nonInteractive > ago({Lookback}), false), strcat("Signed in within the period (last interactive: ", iff(isnull(interactive), "never", format_datetime(interactive, "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm")), ", last non-interactive: ", iff(isnull(nonInteractive), "never", format_datetime(nonInteractive, "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm")), "). Every break-glass sign-in must be accounted for: a planned test or an incident."),
            strcat("No sign-ins within the period. Last interactive sign-in: ", iff(isnull(interactive), "never", format_datetime(interactive, "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm")), "."))),
    (btg | summarize accounts = count() | project Category = "TNT", Check = "TNT.AccountCount", Target = "tenant", Status = iff(accounts < 2, "FAIL", "PASS"),
        Detail = iff(accounts < 2, strcat("Only ", accounts, " break-glass account(s) found. Microsoft recommends at least two, with credentials kept in separate places."), strcat(accounts, " break-glass accounts."))),
    (premium | project Category = "TNT", Check = "TNT.EntraPremium", Target = "tenant", Status = iff(plans > 0, "PASS", "WARN"),
        Detail = iff(plans > 0, "Entra ID P1 or P2 is present, so Conditional Access is licensed.", "No Entra ID P1 or P2 service plan found; Conditional Access may be unlicensed.")),
    (fido
    | extend k = 1
    | join kind=leftouter (fido | mv-expand target = includeTargets | summarize includedIds = make_set(tostring(target.id)) | extend k = 1) on k
    | join kind=inner (btgGroups | extend k = 1) on k
    | extend includedIds = coalesce(includedIds, dynamic([])), enabled = state == "enabled"
    | extend all = set_has_element(includedIds, "all_users"), direct = set_has_element(includedIds, userId),
        viaGroup = array_length(set_intersect(includedIds, groupIds)) > 0
    | project Category = "TNT", Check = "TNT.Fido2MethodEnabled", Target = upn, Status = iff(enabled and (all or direct or viaGroup), "PASS", "FAIL"),
        Detail = case(not(enabled), strcat("The FIDO2 security key method is ", state, "."),
            all, "The FIDO2 security key method is enabled for all users.",
            direct, "The FIDO2 security key method is enabled and targets the account directly.",
            viaGroup, "The FIDO2 security key method is enabled for a group the account is in.",
            "The FIDO2 security key method is enabled, but not for the account or any group it is in, so it can't register or use a key.")),
    (fido
    | mv-expand target = excludeTargets
    | project excludedId = tostring(target.id), k = 1
    | join kind=inner (btgGroups | extend k = 1) on k
    | where excludedId == userId or set_has_element(groupIds, excludedId)
    | project Category = "TNT", Check = "TNT.Fido2NotExcluded", Target = upn, Status = "FAIL",
        Detail = "The account, or a group it is in, is excluded from the FIDO2 method, so it can't sign in with its key."),
    (fido
    | where tobool(keyRestrictions.isEnforced) and tostring(keyRestrictions.enforcementType) == "allow"
    | project Category = "TNT", Check = "TNT.Fido2KeyRestriction", Target = "tenant", Status = "INFO",
        Detail = strcat("Only allowed key models can register (AAGUIDs: ", strcat_array(keyRestrictions.aaGuids, ", "), "). Check that each break-glass key's model is on the list."))
| extend Rank = case(Status == "FAIL", 0, Status == "ERROR", 1, Status == "WARN", 2, Status == "INFO", 3, 4)
| order by Rank asc, Category asc, Check asc, Target asc
| project Category, Check, Target, Status, Detail
